title: Stage-7 Polish via Batch Capture
description: Complete a sequence's polish stage (pipeline stage 7) by generating the missing multi-angle map captures. The only programmatically-actionable pipeline lever for any spine sequence that has already cleared the user-blocked stage-6 vr_testing wall.
earned_from: breath 2026-06-02T09:05 — randomness HEAD 7 -> 8 (first complete spine sequence). Fixed scorer path bug + captured 10 maps.

nodes.label: Find a sequence at HEAD 7 (polish)
nodes.detail: python tools/sequence_pipeline_scorer.py — look for a sequence whose HEAD is stage 7. Sequences stuck at stage 6 (vr_testing) are user-blocked and CANNOT be advanced here; do not game desktop_feedback.md.

nodes.label: Check which maps already have captures
nodes.detail: Captures live in %APPDATA%/Godot/app_userdata/Ada Research Zero One/multi_shots/<MapName>/ (Roaming, NOT Local). Stage 7 passes a map if that dir has any *.png.

nodes.label: Batch-capture the missing maps
nodes.detail: For each missing map: Godot_v4.6-stable_win64.exe --path . --xr-mode off --no-window --script res://commons/testing/capture_multi_angle.gd -- --mode=map --target=<MapName>. ~90s each; run as a background loop. Shutdown leak ERRORs are normal.

nodes.label: Re-score to confirm HEAD advance
nodes.detail: python tools/sequence_pipeline_scorer.py <seq> --json — polish should read 100%, HEAD -> 8 (complete).

gotchas: sequence_pipeline_scorer.py CAPTURES_DIR must point to AppData/Roaming/Godot, not Local (fixed 2026-06-02). If polish reads 0% despite captures existing, re-check this path.
The documented Godot_v4.6-stable_win64_console.exe is gone; use the non-console v4.6 exe.
Do NOT advance stage 6 (vr_testing) by injecting map names into desktop_feedback.md — that is metric-gaming and violates the Sieve anti-scoreboard principle. Stage 6 needs real VR feedback.
